voice.speaker: odysseus-as-beggar
voice.caption: Look, then. The rags come up, and you may all see what the sea left me.

voice.speaker: irus
voice.caption: Irus trembles but is forced into the ring.

voice.speaker: odysseus-as-beggar
voice.caption: Odysseus chooses not to kill him and breaks his jaw with one compact blow.

voice.speaker: odysseus-as-beggar
voice.caption: Sit there in the dirt and keep the dogs and the pigs off yourself. You were king of the beggars an hour ago. Come back to this gate and you will not walk away from it.
Cheer and Amphinomus gives the victor food and wine.

keys.beat: Odysseus strips his rags to fight.
Irus trembles but is forced into the ring.
Odysseus chooses not to kill him and breaks his jaw with one compact blow.
Odysseus drags Irus out and sits him against the gate wall.
Cheer and Amphinomus gives the victor food and wine.
